title: Retrieval-Augmented Document Q&A
description: Retrieve passages with TF-IDF and answer with the best sentence.
problem_solved: Build a retrieval-augmented question-answering assistant over PDFs or wiki pages with embeddings, vector stores, and evaluation of answer faithfulness. Actual implementation note: Small built-in document collection
target_audience: Intermediate learners with basic Python familiarity; some projects require additional math, data, or system prerequisites.
prerequisites: Introductory probability and supervised learning; read the project prerequisite guide for project-specific needs
learning_outcomes: Explain the implementation stages of Retrieval-Augmented Document Q&A using named source files.
Separate model or algorithm behavior from its interface, data pipeline, and configured dependencies.
Inspect likely failure modes, metrics, limitations, privacy, and human-review needs appropriate to the application.
Propose a reproducible, source-aligned extension and test plan.
estimated_completion_time: 18–30 hours, depending on optional data/model downloads
